Edison Intl (EIX) Market Valuation Declined While Transamerica Financial Advisors Decreased Its Holding; Lindsell Train LTD Has Upped Its Dr Pepper Snapple Group (DPS) Holding by $59.99 Million
May 22, 2018 - By Lawrence Diaz
Lindsell Train Ltd increased its stake in Dr Pepper Snapple Group Inc (DPS) by 23.76% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Lindsell Train Ltd bought 618,500 shares as the company’s stock rose 23.05% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 3.22 million shares of the consumer non-durables company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $312.74M, up from 2.60M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Lindsell Train Ltd who had been investing in Dr Pepper Snapple Group Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $21.65B market cap company. The stock increased 0.33% or $0.39 $120.12. About 388,000 shares traded. Dr Pepper Snapple Group, Inc. (NYSE:DPS) has risen 21.65% since May 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 10.10% the S&P500.
Transamerica Financial Advisors Inc decreased its stake in Edison Intl (EIX) by 18.37% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Transamerica Financial Advisors Inc sold 17,740 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.19% with the market. The institutional investor held 78,847 shares of the central company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.99M, down from 96,587 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Transamerica Financial Advisors Inc who had been investing in Edison Intl for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $20.15B market cap company. The stock increased 0.42% or $0.26 $61.83. About 745,674 shares traded. Edison International (NYSE:EIX) has declined 21.55% since May 22, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 33.10% the S&P500.

The company was maintained on Tuesday, May 30 by Jefferies. The rating was maintained by Morgan Stanley with “Overweight” on Thursday, October 26. UBS maintained it with “Neutral” rating and $99 target in Friday, July 28 report. The company was downgraded on Tuesday, January 30 by Wells Fargo. Evercore upgraded the shares of DPS in report on Monday, October 5 to “Buy” rating. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Tuesday, January 30 by Stifel Nicolaus. The rating was maintained by Stifel Nicolaus on Thursday, February 18 with “Buy”.
